text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An exchange student from America, Symboli 
Kris S. Her goal is to bring about a 
"revolution" in the Japanese racing world 
and raise it to an international standard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was the dream of the Japanese mentor 
who had trained her in her youth. As a way 
to repay her teacher, she intended to make 
that dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To achieve her goal, she needed to display 
strength that defied common sense. 
However, her body harbored frailties, so 
pushing too hard was out of the question. 
Strengthening her body was of utmost 
importance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the Junior class is strictly 
for physical conditioning. I have decided 
that demonstrating true strength will be 
reserved for the Classic class onwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the challenge of the Twinkle 
Series with Symboli Kris S had begun.
